raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 13 (ingested 2026-01-18) sends txn_ts as 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS' instead of ISO, so the plain CAST to TIMESTAMP fails. The day values (e.g. 17) are greater than 12 and match the batch's business date (2026-01-17), so the format is unambiguously DD/MM and can be parsed explicitly.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^\\d{2}/\\d{2}/\\d{4} ') THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s;"}}
